output.summary: A rhizome-forming perennial mint hybrid native to temperate and warm-temperate Europe. It occurs in meadows, pastures and disturbed ground, and has wide-spreading fleshy underground stems. In Cuba it is a core ingredient in the mojito cocktail, though other mints may substitute when it is unavailable.
output.edibilityNote: In Cuba it is a core mojito ingredient; the Cuban mojito-mint variety is also grown for other culinary uses.
